items.title: A Course Called Ireland review – why did Bill Murray ever agree to this Irish golf show?
items.summary: The Hollywood star is so grumpy in this new travelogue it’s like he wishes he wasn’t there. Think sulky car journeys, strained encounters and the sense of a TV series imploding A Course Called Ireland is a new documentary in which Bill Murray golfs his way around the “Emerald Isle” while reflecting on everything from his great-grandmother to worms.

items.title: Serbia election: Vucic concedes defeat to student-led movement

items.title: Kristiansund rotet bort poeng
items.summary: Kristiansund ledet 2–0 og bommet på straffe mot KFUM Oslo i eliteserien søndag. Det ble kostbart; i 2. omgang slo KFUM Oslo tilbake og utlignet til 2–2. KBK ligger fremdeles under streken. Opp til Aalesund på kvalifiseringsplass er det fire poeng.
